name: Winterfest and Light Up Wildwood Christmas Parade
when_note: Friday, December 4, 6 to 9 PM; parade at 6 PM and tree lighting at 7:30 PM
paras: The City of Wildwood holds its annual Winterfest and Light Up Parade on Friday, December 4, 2026 at Wildwood City Hall, 100 N. Main St. The city's calendar lists the evening from 6 to 9 PM with free admission for all ages.
The Christmas parade steps off at 6 PM with floats made by community members and local businesses, and a tree lighting ceremony follows at 7:30 PM in the City Hall courtyard.
Families will find vendors, s'mores, a kids' zone, food trucks and a special visit from Santa, and the city lists 352-461-0134 for questions.
Parade entry forms and a Winterfest application are posted under the city's forms and applications page.
tip: Claim a curb spot before 6 PM, then stay for the courtyard tree lighting.

name: Moonlight Christmas Parade and Santa's Workshop in Minneola
host: the City of Minneola events page
venue: South Main Avenue and Minneola Library
address: South Main Avenue from Virginia Street to Pearl Street, Minneola, FL 34715
when_note: Saturday, December 12, parade at 6 PM and Santa's Workshop from 7 to 9 PM
paras: Minneola's Moonlight Parade and Santa's Workshop takes over South Main Avenue on Saturday, December 12, 2026, with the city's events page listing 6 to 9 PM.
The 9th Annual Moonlight Christmas Parade begins at 6 PM and travels along South Main Avenue from Virginia Street to Pearl Street, and viewers are asked to bring an unwrapped toy for Santa's sleigh.
Afterward families can walk to Santa's Workshop at the Minneola Library, 302 W. Pearl St., from 7 to 9 PM for photos with Santa, holiday crafts and sweet treats.
Local businesses and organizations can enter a float at no cost, and the city's website carries vendor forms and a route map.
tip: Bring an unwrapped toy for Santa's sleigh and plan to walk to the library after the parade.

name: 51st Annual Cracker Christmas Parade and Festival in Umatilla
host: the Umatilla Chamber of Commerce events calendar
paras: The Umatilla Chamber of Commerce lists the 51st Annual Cracker Christmas Parade and Festival on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 9 AM to 2 PM, with the theme ORANGE you glad it's Christmas.
The chamber's calendar asks parade participants and festival vendors to email the chamber at Umatilla@UmatillaChamber.org for details.
Local family calendars list the day as free, with the chamber's office at 23 South Central Avenue and the phone number 352-669-3511.
The chamber's December calendar also lists a Paws and Claws event on December 6 from 11 AM to 2 PM and a Christmas party hosted by the Florida Elks on December 19.
tip: Arrive early since parade line-up starts at dawn and the route fills quickly.

name: 10th Annual Santa Paws for the Cause in Cocoa Village
address: Myrth Tharpe Square, Historic Cocoa Village, Cocoa, FL
paras: Cocoa Village hosts the 10th Annual Santa Paws for the Cause on Sunday, December 6, 2026 from noon to 3 PM at Myrth Tharpe Square, where families and their pets can pose with Santa.
The $10 photo package includes a digital and printed photo with a festive frame, plus treat bags for four-legged friends, and all proceeds benefit Great Dane Love.
Guests can tell Santa their favorite treat from Tails at the Barkery, and the last photo is taken at 2:45 PM before Santa heads back to the North Pole at 3 PM.
The listing invites the entire family to dress up and make a holiday card photo.
tip: Plan to get in line before 2:45 PM, when the last photo is taken.
